name: threads
description: Track open questions, doubts and ideas as threads in a side pane, per session or per project, with Claude-suggested threads

suggestions.title: Suggested threads
suggestions.description: on: Claude proposes threads it sees left open, shown in the pane's Suggested block. off: no tool, no prompt text.

paneVisibility.title: Open the pane automatically
paneVisibility.description: at-start: when a session starts. at-suggestion: the first time Claude suggests a thread. manual: only /threads opens it.

doneRetention.title: Finished threads
doneRetention.description: keep: they stay in the Done list. delete: they are removed 30 seconds after you finish them, with an Undo.
